subject: Sales→CS: Atlas Health onboarding blueprint & launch-week action grid
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Atlas Health onboarding blueprint & launch-week schedule

Irene — quick summary and ask for handoff to CS.

Recap (deal context):
- Account: Atlas Health (payer-facing analytics platform).
- ARR: $420k committed (12-month), Dedicated pool reserved: 4x A100-equivalent GPUs starting 2027-01-02.
- Primary contacts: Lena Ortiz (Sr PM, lena@atlas-health.com); procurement@atlas-health.com.
- Key success metric: first 90-day inference stability at <=150ms p50 for 2k concurrent users.

Why I’m looping you in: sales has completed technical validation and signed the SOW (attached v1). We need CS to own the next milestones: kickoff, environment access, S3/KMS onboarding, canary plan, and go/no-go gate.

Planned timeline (high level):
- 2026-12-20: kickoff (60m) — introduce tech leads, review runbook, identify blockers
- 2026-12-22 to 2027-01-05: preflight (network, KMS, data sync, model pin)
- 2027-01-06 to 2027-01-09: canary ramp and acceptance tests
- 2027-01-10: go-live target

Known risks / notes:
- Procurement asked for two small redlines in SOW around data retention and audit access (cc procurement on next message to coordinate).
- Atlas wants isolated logging to their Splunk instance — we scoped a short connector task in the SOW.
- They may request longer retention for audit logs; need CS input on operational impact.

Attachments: RDW-ATL-2026-042_SOW_v1.pdf, Atlas_Onboarding_Runbook_v0.9.xlsx, implementation-map.png

Ask for CS:
1) Please confirm who will be the Implementation Lead and who will be the Customer Success sponsor.
2) Confirm 2026-12-20 kickoff availability and owner for the calendar invite.
3) Quick sanity-check on the canary acceptance criteria (I listed latency target above).

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the context, Jordan — good summary. I’ll own coordinating the handoff and setting expectations with the Atlas team. Responses inline below and actions I’m taking: 

1) Owners
- Implementation Lead: Marissa Cole (cc’d) — will lead the kickoff and runbook delivery.
- CS Sponsor / Post-go-live: Ben Carter (cc’d) — will own NRR & success metrics post go-live.

2) Kickoff timing
- 2026-12-20 works for our team; Marissa will send the formal calendar invite to Atlas and include the pre-kickoff questionnaire.

3) Canary / acceptance criteria
- Latency target (<=150ms p50 @ 2k concurrency): feasible assuming the dedicated pool and batching profile described. We should add a throughput validation step where we confirm p95 for background traffic.

Open items I need from Sales before I loop Atlas: 
- Final SOW with the two procurement redline placeholders resolved (procurement wants a short clause on retention windows + audit access). If procurement has edits, we’ll handle via an appendix.
- KMS key owner email (for role grants) and a list of Splunk ingestion endpoints.

Marissa, Ben — can you confirm you’re good to take these owners? I’ll draft a kickoff agenda and a short pre-kickoff checklist (access + test data + roles) and share in the Drive link.

I’m attaching a lightweight action-grid template (implementation-map.png) that I’ll populate with owners and dates once Marissa confirms.

Thanks,
Irene

Hi all — thanks for the intro. I’m confirmed as Implementation Lead and will run the kickoff on 2026-12-20. Calendar invite has been sent (link below). A few practical items before kickoff: 

Pre-kickoff checklist (please complete by 2026-12-18):
- Atlas: provide KMS key owner email and add redwood-service-account@atlas-health.com as a KMS principal (or confirm we should request a service account).
- Atlas: provide Splunk ingestion endpoint + firewall IP allowlist for our dedicated pool.
- Atlas: provide a minimal sample dataset for smoke validation (PII / anonymized).
- Redwood (Marissa): populate the runbook with roles, contact roster, and initial acceptance test steps (attached: Atlas_Onboarding_Runbook_v0.9.xlsx).

Acceptance criteria (draft):
- Successful inference at target latency <=150ms p50 and p95 under threshold during a 30-minute stability run at 75% expected concurrency.
- Model pinned to v1.2 in dedicated pool and KV cache primed with test prefixes.
- Logs forwarded to Atlas Splunk endpoint and ephemeral audit log export validated.

Attachments: Atlas_Onboarding_Runbook_v0.9.xlsx (runbook worksheet), implementation-map.png (action grid)

Drive folder with agenda & pre-kickoff form: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Atl4sOnb0ard-example
Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=atlas-kickoff-20261220

If procurement sends the SOW redlines, Jordan — please share them and I’ll incorporate the appendix. Otherwise we’ll proceed with the kickoff and record the pending retention clarification as a risk item.

Thanks — looking forward to working with Atlas.
